verses.text: And YHWH said to me: “Again go, love a woman loved by another and is committing adultery, according to the love of YHWH [for] the sons of Israel, and they are turning to other gods and are loving the cakes of raisins!”

segments.text: And YHWH said to me: “Again go, love a woman loved by another and is committing adultery, according to the love of YHWH [for] the sons of Israel, and they are turning to other gods and are loving the cakes of raisins!”

verses.text: And I bought her for myself with fifteen [shekels] of silver and a homer of barley and a lethech of barley.

segments.text: And I bought her for myself with fifteen [shekels] of silver and a homer of barley and a lethech of barley.

verses.text: And I said to her: “Many days you will dwell with me; you will not act like a prostitute, and you will not be unto a man; I also toward you.”

segments.text: And I said to her: “Many days you will dwell with me; you will not act like a prostitute, and you will not be unto a man; I also toward you.”

verses.text: For many days the sons of Israel will dwell without a king and without a prince, and without a sacrifice and without a pillar, and without an ephod or a teraphim.

segments.text: For many days the sons of Israel will dwell without a king and without a prince, and without a sacrifice and without a pillar, and without an ephod or a teraphim.

verses.text: Afterward the sons of Israel will return, and they will seek YHWH their God and David their king, and they will come trembling to YHWH and to His goodness in the latter days.

segments.text: Afterward the sons of Israel will return, and they will seek YHWH their God and David their king, and they will come trembling to YHWH and to His goodness in the latter days.
